heading: Uniform residential loan application
lead: Not later than 6 months after July 11, 2026, the Director shall require each enterprise to—

tree.text: include a military service question on the form known as the Uniform Residential Loan Application to include selection options of “Yes”, “No”, and “Prefer Not To Answer”; and
position the question described in paragraph (1) above the signature line of the Uniform Residential Loan Application.

notes.heading: Regulations
notes.text: Pub. L. 119–101, title VI, § 603(b)(2), July 11, 2026, 140 Stat. 955, provided that: “Not later than 6 months after the date of enactment of this Act [July 11, 2026], the Director of the Federal Housing Finance Agency shall issue a rule to carry out the amendment made by this section [probably means this subsection, enacting this section].”

sourceCredit: (Pub. L. 102–550, title XIII, § 1330, as added Pub. L. 119–101, title VI, § 603(b)(1), July 11, 2026, 140 Stat. 954.)
